document:0:630:0.text:
Appearance: Cloudy green suspension.
Effect: Temporarily separates a Graveborn's soul from their body.
Recipe: Simmer a <style="highlight">large boneshroom</style> and a <style="highlight">dried spiritroot</style> in a pot of water until the earthy smell disappears.
Warning: Do not administer to the living.
document:0:630:0.source_cn:
性状：绿色悬浊液
效果：令亡灵的灵魂暂时脱离躯体
配方：将<style="highlight">大朵骨爪菌</style>和<style="highlight">晒干的灵蔓根</style>放入盛满水的锅中熬煮，直到散发的土腥味消失，即为炼制成功。
注意事项：不可用于生者之身
